rules.notes: The rule-distance probe's rule (docs/guides/probe.md). Its text carries a per-run value that probe.sh fills in, so the registry holds the wording with a placeholder. At shadow it guards nothing: probe_ack advances the run on every exit but far_redeliver's re-delivery hold, which is bounded at two. Registered after the baseline pin, so it has no baseline key.
